# A3X.AI

A3X.AI is a Artificial Intelligence company. A3X.AI delivers active intelligence applications that help enterprises own and compound their decision-making layer. A3X.AI employs 3 people, founded in 2026. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and India.

## About

A3X.AI is an Agentic Factory for Analytics and Data Science that helps enterprises rapidly create, deploy, and operate intelligent decisioning applications.

We are building for the new era of agentic analytics, data science, and decisioning. AI can help build and operate these intelligent systems.

These applications are always-on, continuously improving, and interactive: they can monitor signals, surface insights, drive action, and improve outcomes over time (Have a built-in harness).

Tokenized analytics makes this scalable, reducing the time and cost required to produce high-quality apps, models, workflows, and analytical outputs.

A3X.AI factory can build fully operational applications in record time through highly performant spec driven AI development.
